notes.title: Improved Compatibility
notes.content:
We've released a new update for MDK on Steam that improves compatibility and overall performance on newer hardware.

Changelog
- Added D3D wrapper
- Added back missing Glide files

A prompt will allow players to switch between both versions at launch. If you continue to have problems with the default D3D version of the game we recommend switching to the Glide release. Players that wish to play the game on older hardware or undo our wrapper changes can rename or delete "ddraw.dll" from the MDK install directory and launch the game as normal.

For all other support enquires we encourage players to contact Interplay support at customerservice@interplay.com.
